barbarian.Title: Rage
barbarian.Tagline: A primal warrior who channels an inner rage in battle, able to shrug off terrible blows and strike with raw force.

bard.Title: Bardic Inspiration
bard.Tagline: An artist and adventurer whose magic draws on inspiration, music and words; versatile in combat as in society.

cleric.Title: Divine Favor
cleric.Tagline: An intermediary between the mortal world and divine powers, healing and fighting in the name of their deity.

druid.Title: Call of the Wild
druid.Tagline: A guardian of nature who draws magic from the elements and wildlife, able to shapeshift into a wild creature.

fighter.Title: Martial Mastery
fighter.Tagline: A master of weapons and armor, trained in every form of martial combat.

monk.Title: Way of Ki
monk.Tagline: An unarmed combatant who channels an inner energy (Ki) to strike fast and hard without armor or heavy weapons.

paladin.Title: Sacred Oath
paladin.Tagline: A holy warrior bound by an oath, blending martial prowess with divine magic in service of a cause.

ranger.Title: Hunter's Instinct
ranger.Tagline: A hunter and scout at ease in the wilds, combining combat skill with subtle nature magic.

rogue.Title: Art of Cunning
rogue.Tagline: An expert in stealth and cunning, deadly with sneak attacks and skilled at bypassing traps and locks.

sorcerer.Title: Innate Magic
sorcerer.Tagline: A spellcaster whose magic springs from an innate gift rather than study, often tied to a bloodline or a supernatural event.

warlock.Title: Otherworldly Pact
warlock.Tagline: A spellcaster bound by a pact to a powerful entity, drawing power from it in exchange for service or loyalty.

wizard.Title: Arcane Lore
wizard.Tagline: A scholar of arcane magic, whose meticulous learning shapes reality through spells.

Conditions.Title: Conditions
Conditions.ExhaustionTooltip: Cumulative exhaustion level (0-6). Each level adds its own penalty: disadvantage on checks (1), speed halved (2), disadvantage on attacks/saves (3), max HP halved (4), speed reduced to 0 (5), death (6).

Fields.GmOnlyNotice: Locked sheet: only the GM can edit this Feature. Use the dedicated button on the Features tab to spend a charge.
Fields.EquipmentGmOnlyNotice: Locked sheet: only the GM can edit this item (rules content). Use the Quantity/Equipped fields on the Inventory tab to manage it.
Fields.CompendiumGmOnlyNotice: Locked sheet: only the GM can edit this compendium content.
Fields.SlotTwoHandedNote: Two-handed weapon: automatically occupies both Main hand AND Off hand.
Fields.OffHandRequiresLightNote: Only Light weapons can be equipped in the Off hand.
Fields.UniversalHelp: Automatically granted to any character at the required level, regardless of class (e.g. Opportunity Attack) — the Class field is then ignored.
Fields.ClassKeyHelp: Identifies this description sheet for the character sheet's "View sheet" button — unrelated to the world's language.
Fields.ReactionTriggerHelp: Describes when to use this Reaction (e.g. "When a creature you can see within 60 ft. is hit by an attack").
Fields.CostsResource: Draws from pool (exact name of another Feature, e.g. Ki)
Fields.UsesHelp: Leave Maximum at 0 for a feature that is always available (no tracking).
Fields.SpellHealHelp: If set, rolls this die + the spellcasting ability modifier when cast, and shows an "Apply Healing" button on the chat card.
Fields.SpellLight: Light emitted (optional, e.g. the Light cantrip)
